user_query: I'm planning a surprise party for my best friend and I want to make it extra special. Can you help me by providing a list of face uids in my face recognition database? Additionally, I need to know the current version of the general classification service and get recommendations for alternative image classification algorithms.

TaskList.description: Retrieve a list of face UIDs from the face recognition database.
Get the current version of the general classification service.
Get recommendations for alternative image classification algorithms.
